verify_detail: he app was launched before, by CI or other tests, rather than on anything the test itself controls.\n\n**Fix direction:** either make the test call `nerve_clear_app_data`/reinstall before each run so `launchCount` always starts at 0, or better, fix `SyncComponent` so the UI doesn\'t get stuck at "Sync unavailable" with no retry affordance when the init check is skipped — that\'s arguably the real product bug, since a user landing on launches #3/#5 of any 5-cycle has no way to retry sync at all.'
